text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black receives soul-shattering news from Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since Satono Diamond hasn't shown signs of being race-ready, she has no choice but to give up on debuting alongside Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The best of friends now have to travel separate paths, and their promise of running together in the Triple Crown will never come to pass.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Kitasan Black decides to act as an older sister figure to Satono Diamond and help guide her toward her debut next year.
